Author: D.Ramesh

entities.text: A R Sadiq vs State Of Andhra Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
THE HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE D.RAMESH  Criminal Petition No.3551 OF 2020 Order: (Heard and pronounced through Blue Jeans App (virtual) mode,
since this mode is adopted on account of prevalence of COVID-19 Pandemic)

This is a Criminal Petition filed under section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 to release the seized stock in connection with Crime No.87 of 2020, dated 13.08.2020 of Station House Officer, Chinaganjam Police Station, Prakasam District for the offences punishable under sections 188, 270,
273, 328 r/w 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (for short 'IPC')
and Section 24(1) r/w 27 of the Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products Act, 2003 (for short 'COTPA' Act) and Section 59(i) of Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 (for short 'FSS Act').
2. Heard the counsel for the petitioners and the Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent.
3. During the course of hearing, the learned counsel for the petitioners represented that the subject matter of the Criminal Petition is squarely covered by the order dated 27.08.2020 in Crl.P.No.3409 of 2020, wherein this Court while disposing the petition directed the respondent-State therein to return the seized property in connection with crime stated therein.

In view of the aforesaid, it is urged that same orders may be passed in A R Sadiq vs State Of Andhra Pradesh, on 2 September, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/38953788/
1

entities.text: A R Sadiq vs State Of Andhra Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned Public Prosecutor appearing for respondent-State did not oppose the said submission.

2 4. Considering the submissions and in view of the fact this matter is squarely covered by the earlier orders, the Criminal Petition is allowed directing the respondent-State to return the seized property in connection with No.87 of 2020, dated 13.08.2020 of Station House Officer, Chinaganjam Police Station, Prakasam District, within a period of one (1) week from today under proper acknowledgment.

As a sequel thereto, miscellaneous petitions, if any,
pending shall also closed.

_______________  D.RAMESH, J.
Date: 02.09.2020 KA THE HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE D.RAMESH
